i18n_cover.bare_text: %(file)s:%(lineno)d bare natural-language text in the core %(text)r — user-facing messages must go through M(<literal code>, **params); selftest labels must be ids per decision 1C
i18n_cover.code_not_literal: the code passed to `M(...)` must be a string literal (%(file)s:%(lineno)d, got %(kind)s) — a variable / conditional / concatenated code makes pack completeness unprovable
i18n_cover.empty_scan: scan surface is empty — finding no source is not a language-free pass (zero-value guard)
i18n_cover.fixture_literal: `%(file)s:%(lineno)d` has a Chinese literal in a self-test fixture (%(text)r) — fixtures land in the scan surface; build them from codepoints (`chr(CJK_LO)` / `_cj(n)`) or use English-only samples
i18n_cover.ok: Language coverage gate: OK (%(files)d files have a language-free core; language packs optional)
i18n_cover.parse_error: %(file)s cannot be parsed: %(error)s — a parse failure must not count as a pass
i18n_cover.scan_empty_dir: scan surface %(root)s is empty — finding no source is not a language-free pass
i18n_cover.title: Language coverage gate
